notes.title: Some feedback on demo?
notes.notes:
Since the game is still under development I'd appriciate any feedback if you'd tried the demo version. You can report here bugs, problems, etc. Or maybe you'd like you share with me your thoughts that game induced in you - that'd be great. Anyhow I will continue working on game and keep you updated. 

Since you can't write a review for a demo version, please contact me by email almost.robin.studio@gmail.com or write something in a discussion section.

notes.title: Bleak End Demo version is now released!
notes.notes:
I'm trilled to tell you that the demo version is now avalible to play! Turn off light and immerge yourself in a melancholic atmosphere that will confront you with futility and sorrow.

Please note, that the game is still under development and not fully polished yet. I will keep it updating as I work on it. And I'd appreciate your feedback!

notes.title: Demo version will be released tomorrow!
notes.notes: I'm excited to announce that the BLEAK END demo version will be released tomorrow!
